In regards to the post Multiply by Two (https://voat.co/v/puzzles/comments/824589)) i would like to explain that the purpose of the exercise was not mathematics, but as the post said an exercise in alternative thinking.

The wording was somewhat misleading to the area of mathematics but this is a puzzles board so nothing can be taken literally unless you are given restrictions in that direction.

One of the definitions of the word formula is : "a method or procedure for achieving something" so you can achieve the goal of the exercise by any means.

Let's say i opted for defining my unit as a pack of cards (a stack with more than one card), given that when i cut that pack of cards i'll get 2 packs of cards, effectively multiplying my unit by two. It works with any number of positive packs of cards following the formula : cut each pack of cards once, my operation being "cut".

I could've defined my unit as being a number in binary (base 2) and my formula being shifting the bits to the left once (filling the new bit with 0) and that way i could achieve the multiplication of that unit by two.

I could've defined a bacteria as my unit and my formula as its growth, more specifically one division, to achieve the goal of the "puzzle".

I'm sorry to those who saw the post as a mathematical prowess challenge, it was not its intention.
